records.source: Lives deep in the ocean but likes to lay its eggs in the warm summer water.
records.translation: Naninirahan sa kailaliman ng karagatan ngunit gustong mangitlog sa mainit na tubig tuwing tag-init.

records.englishResidueReason: Bass is the conventional common species name used to distinguish this specific game fish.

records.translation: Aba, perpekto ang balot na mumo.

records.source: A flower that can bloom in the winter.
Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o pagandahin ang iyong mga sahig.

records.source: A delicate fruit that pops up from the snow.
records.translation: Maselang prutas na sumusulpot mula sa niyebe.

records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o pagandahin ang iyong mga sahig.

records.source: Increases your chance to catch rare fish.
records.translation: Pinatataas ang tsansa mong makahuli ng bihirang isda.

records.source: A traditional spring flower that makes a nice gift.
records.translation: Tradisyonal na bulaklak sa tagsibol na magandang iregalo.

records.preserveReason: Dandelion is the conventional borrowed common name for this specific flower in Filipino usage.

records.source: Not the prettiest flower, but the leaves make a good salad.
records.translation: Hindi ito ang pinakamagandang bulaklak, ngunit masarap gawing ensalada ang mga dahon.

records.source: A replica of an ancient pot.
Causes fish to bite even faster and increases size of the "fishing bar".
records.translation: Lalo pang pinabibilis ang pagkagat ng isda at pinalalaki ang "bar ng pangingisda".

records.source: Greatly improves soil quality, increasing your chance to grow quality crops. Mix into tilled soil.
records.translation: Lubhang pinahuhusay ang kalidad ng lupa at pinatataas ang tsansang magpatubo ng de-kalidad na pananim. Ihalo sa binungkal na lupa.

records.source: This soil has a 100% chance of staying watered overnight. Mix into tilled soil.
records.translation: May 100% tsansang manatiling nadiligan ang lupang ito magdamag. Ihalo sa binungkal na lupa.

records.preserveReason: The canonical Filipino glossary explicitly retains the hyphenated brand name Deluxe Speed-Gro unchanged.

records.source: Stimulates leaf production. Guaranteed to increase growth rate by at least 25%. Mix into tilled soil.
records.translation: Pinasisigla ang pagdami ng dahon. Garantisadong pinatataas nang hindi bababa sa 25% ang bilis ng paglaki. Ihalo sa binungkal na lupa.
Basagin upang makakuha ng mga diyamante.

records.source: A giant dino egg... The entire shell is still intact!
records.translation: Napakalaking itlog ng dinosauro... Buo pa ang buong balat!

records.source: It's thick and creamy, with a vivid green hue. It smells like grass and leather.
records.translation: Malapot at malinamnam ito, na may matingkad na berdeng kulay. Amoy damo at katad.

records.source: This'll keep you warm in the cold sea air.
records.translation: Pananatilihin ka nitong mainit sa malamig na hangin ng dagat.

records.source: It can occur in coral reefs, often near an underwater volcano.
records.translation: Maaari itong mabuo sa mga bahura ng korales, madalas malapit sa bulkan sa ilalim ng tubig.
